chapter_note: Substrate-dominant chapter built on parabolic similes mapping cosmic figures (First Man, Ambassador/Third Messenger, Ship/abode, Living Spirit) onto archetypal images (famous man whose property is taken, wise craftsman, warrior rescuing captive prince). The similes stay strictly within the cosmic drama — both sides are mythic. Editorial seams are limited to dialogue frames ("Once again he said") and a clear hortatory closing addressed to the disciples ("become choosers and redeemers of your soul"). Heavy manuscript damage (80% damage ratio) makes some segments fragmentary.
